_giong_du_phong._note: Da do phoi tan tren cung mot cau. lech_tb = khoang cach so voi giong goc cua kenh (cang nho cang giong). nhip = do dai cau mau; nhip goc cua kenh la 7.16s.

Ngoc Tuyet.luu_y: Tong sat nhat (2k-4k chi lech +0.6dB) nhung doc rat cham, phai ep 1.7x. Nhan la vi-northern pha Nam.

Tuyet.luu_y: Mien Nam that, tong tot, nhung v3 doc qua cham cho nhip quang cao.

_da_chot.ly_do: Giong Sai Gon that (khong phai nhan vi-standard hay pha Bac), nhip 8.88s gan nhip goc 7.16s nhat trong nhom v3. Sau khi can tong, lech con 2.91 dB.

nhac_nen._note: Duong dan tuong doi tu thu muc voice-convert. Dat rong de khong chen nhac.

_giai_thich.duck_db: nhac lui bao nhieu dB khi co tieng noi (2-14)
_giai_thich.notch_db: ha dai 1.8kHz cua nhac de nhuong cho phu am

nhac_nen._da_chot: Muc 'Ro' — nhac thap hon giong 16 dB. Nguoi dung nghe 3 muc roi chon (2026-09-03).
nhac_nen._canh_bao_do_dac: Khong do muc nhac tren ban DA TRON: tram cua giong at het, nhac o -29 dB chi nang tong len 1 dB. Muon do thi trich rieng luong nhac sau ducking.
